title.zh: 德国监管机构拒绝 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 交易仍处暂停状态
title.en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application

current_state.zh: BaFin 拒绝了 Futurum Bank AG 的 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 自 6 月 12 日起交易基本暂停，欧元存款暂停，但加密资产提现仍开放。平台计划将交易和托管外包给两家未具名的受监管德国合作方，Futurum Bank 将在资产转移前继续持有资产；无恢复日期，公司可在一个月内提出异议或重新申请。
current_state.en: BaFin rejected Futurum Bank AG's MiCA application, leaving Bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June 12 and euro deposits halted, while crypto withdrawals remain open. The platform plans to outsource trading and custody to two unidentified regulated German partners, with Futurum Bank continuing to hold assets until transfer; no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply.

updates.what_changed_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin Group SE subsidiary futurum bank AG's MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorization, leaving bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June while the company pursues an alternative model through regulated partners.

updates.title_zh: MiCA 申请被拒迫使德国加密平台进行运营全面调整
updates.title_en: MiCA rejection forces German crypto platform into operational overhaul
updates.what_changed_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
updates.what_changed_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.
updates.current_state_zh: BaFin 拒绝了 Futurum Bank AG 的 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 自 6 月 12 日起交易基本暂停，欧元存款暂停，但加密资产提现仍开放。平台计划将交易和托管外包给两家未具名的受监管德国合作方，Futurum Bank 将在资产转移前继续持有资产；无恢复日期，公司可在一个月内提出异议或重新申请。
updates.current_state_en: BaFin rejected Futurum Bank AG's MiCA application, leaving Bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June 12 and euro deposits halted, while crypto withdrawals remain open. The platform plans to outsource trading and custody to two unidentified regulated German partners, with Futurum Bank continuing to hold assets until transfer; no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.
updates.detailed_summary_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.
